name: Flag on Omission
description: Authored by HyperContent. A reshaped format is a smaller surface than the original, so the risk is that a required element is lost in the reshaping — a figure without its caveat, a claim without its attribution. This skill flags stories carrying an unqualified figure or a claim with no provenance, so the executor keeps the required companion travelling with the element in every derived telling. Flag, never rewrite: a human makes the call.

advert.role: required-element coverage guard for derived formats

rules.name: Figure present — required caveat must travel with it
rules.description: A hard number in the story meaning (casualty count, category, magnitude) must keep its verification caveat and attribution in every reshaped telling.
rules.detail_template: The story carries a figure ('{match}'). Ensure its verification caveat and attribution travel with it in every derived telling — a feed card or a reel must not show the number alone.
rules.rationale: In a shorter format the caveat is the first thing dropped. This flags the figure so the required companion is preserved through reshaping. Flag, not hold — the editor decides.

rules.name: Claim with no provenance
rules.description: A story whose meaning carries no provenance references cannot have its sourcing preserved through reshaping; flag it before any derived telling is built.
rules.detail_template: No provenance references on the story meaning. A derived telling cannot preserve sourcing that isn't there — attach provenance before reshaping.
rules.rationale: Omission guard: what a telling must not drop. Fires only when provenance is genuinely absent, so a well-sourced story stays silent.
